sentences.text: New Shipbuilding Oy is a company registered on 2026-07-20 under the industry code 30110, building of civilian ships and floating structures.
A first hire, first sales, a start-up notification and a board change are all dated 2026-07-20.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is on the thesis list, but no public record yet shows technology or growth.
